steps.text: Hello, you've reached {{bank_name}}'s AI specialist. This call is recorded.
Hi Olivia, how can I help you today?
Hi, I'm just after my balance, thanks. I'm about to pay a tradie and want to make sure there's enough in there.

steps.summary: Olivia wants her balance before making a payment.

steps.text: Easy done. I've just sent a notification to your banking app. Please tap Approve when you see it, and I'll wait on the line.
Thanks Olivia. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. Your Everyday account has ${{get_customer_overview.accounts.0.available_balance|a healthy balance}} available right now.
Great. And has everything gone through from the last few days? Nothing stuck?
Thanks, just a moment while I check that for you.
Thanks for holding. I've looked through the last four days and your card purchases have gone through normally. I can't see anything on hold.
Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks!

steps.summary: Balance and recent transactions confirmed. Nothing further needed.

steps.text: No worries, Olivia. Have a lovely day.
